title: Orthogonality of distinct error subspaces
statement: Let $C \le \mathcal{H}_n$ be a code that is non-degenerate for $t$-error correction, and let $E, F$ be Pauli strings on $n$ qubits with weights $\mathrm{wt}(E) \le t$ and $\mathrm{wt}(F) \le t$ and $E \neq F$. Then the images $\hat{E}(C)$ and $\hat{F}(C)$ of $C$ under the corresponding Pauli operators are orthogonal subspaces of $\mathcal{H}_n$; that is, $\langle \hat{E}\,u,\, \hat{F}\,v\rangle = 0$ for all $u, v \in C$.
hypotheses_covered: C is non-degenerate for t-error correction
E and F are Pauli strings on n qubits
weight of E at most t
weight of F at most t
E is not equal to F
replaced:
If $C$ is non-degenerate and $E \neq F$ both have weight $\le t$, then
$\hat{E}(C) \perp \hat{F}(C)$.
